  -- Result: Decided to engage WebSurfer with specific search queries for both authors' birth years.
Data_Flow: []

  -- Observation: Found multiple results (Wikipedia, celebrity-birthdays.com, Encyclopedia.com) stating Emma Bull was born December 13, 1954.
  -- Thought: Confirmed the birth year is 1954; noted Wikipedia as a primary source but planned to seek Britannica corroboration later.
  -- Result: Provided Emma Bull's birth date (December 13, 1954) to the Planner.

  to_step: 3
  source_agent: WebSurfer
  target_agent: Planner

  correctness: correct
  confidence: 0.95

  -- Observation: Found Britannica snippet and other sources confirming Virginia Woolf was born January 25, 1882.

  -- Result: Provided Virginia Woolf's birth date (January 25, 1882) to the Planner.

  -- Thought: Since Britannica lacks an entry for Emma Bull, will use secondary credible sources (SF Encyclopedia, Encyclopedia.com) to corroborate the 1954 birth year.
  -- Result: Confirmed Emma Bull's birth year as 1954 via non-Britannica sources.
